title: Exploding Liquids
description: Discover the power of supercritical fluids in a unique state of matter

scenes.narration: Liquids can explode under extreme pressure
When a liquid is compressed to its critical point
it becomes a supercritical fluid with unique properties
no longer a liquid or gas but something in between
this phase allows for unusual reactions and applications
unlocking new possibilities in science and industry

title: Exploding Liquids
description: Understand the power of supercritical fluids in everyday life

scenes.narration: When liquids explode they can be deadly, but what triggers this explosion
The answer lies in supercritical fluids, where pressure and temperature meet
At this point liquids become highly compressible and expand rapidly
Causing a massive release of energy that can be catastrophic
Understanding supercritical fluids is key to harnessing their power
And unlocking new technologies that can change our world, literally

title: Exploding Liquids
description: Discover the power of supercritical fluids in a shocking experiment.

scenes.narration: Liquids can explode if heated past their supercritical point.
This point is where the liquid and gas phases merge.
They can diffuse through solids like a gas.
And dissolve materials like a liquid.
The result is a powerful explosion.
